chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Mukhtar, from Zayd Al-Shahham, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), peace be upon him, who said:
The Ziyarah (visitation) of the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) equals twenty Hajjs and superior, and [is equal] to twenty Umrahs and a Hajj.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward of visiting the grave of Imam Al-Husayn (AS)?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (as) to emphasize the unique status of Karbala as a spiritual center rivaling Mecca. The equivalence to twenty Hajjs and Umrahs reflects the Shia scholarly view that the martyrdom of Imam al-Husayn (as) serves as a continuous act of worship and redemption for the community. This hadith underscores the theological importance of Ziyarah as a means of drawing near to Allah through the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Al Husayn Bin Al Mukhtar, from Zayd Al Shahham,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘A Ziyarah of the grave of Al-Husaynasws equates to twenty Hajjs and superior, and from twenty Umrahs and Hajj’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Husayn ibn al- Mukhtar from Zayd al-Shahham who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that visiting the gravesite of al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al- Salam, is equal in rewards to twenty Hajjah. It is even more virtuous than ‘Umrah and Hajjah.”
